inputs.description: Local TCP port to forward for Web Inspector

tasks.label: Tizen: Install
tasks.command: SDB=$(command -v sdb || echo "$HOME/tizen-studio/tools/sdb"); WGT=$(ls Debug/TvSample.wgt TvSample/Debug/TvSample.wgt 2>/dev/null | head -1); echo "Installing $WGT"; "$SDB" -s ${input:tvIp} push "$WGT" /home/owner/share/tmp/sdk_tools/tmp/ && "$SDB" -s ${input:tvIp} shell 0 vd_appinstall 5fohnTCUqe.TvSample /home/owner/share/tmp/sdk_tools/tmp/TvSample.wgt

tasks.label: Tizen: Debug (Web Inspector)
tasks.command: SDB=$(command -v sdb || echo "$HOME/tizen-studio/tools/sdb"); OUT=$("$SDB" -s ${input:tvIp} shell 0 debug 5fohnTCUqe.TvSample); echo "$OUT"; PORT=$(echo "$OUT" | grep -o 'port: *[0-9]*' | grep -o '[0-9]*' | tail -1); echo "Web Inspector port: $PORT"; "$SDB" -s ${input:tvIp} forward tcp:${input:debugPort} tcp:$PORT && open -a "Google Chrome" "http://127.0.0.1:${input:debugPort}"
